title: Request for Crime Stoppers Report Linked to Alfredo Shaw and the Tony Von Carruthers Case

communications.subject: Tennessee Public Records Act Request: Untitled
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Tennessee Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Subject: Records Request—Alfredo Shaw and CrimeStoppers Report Concerning Tony Von Carruthers

To the Memphis Police Department:

I request records concerning Alfredo Bernard Shaw, also known as Jake Wright and identified as MPD informant #1069, FBI confidential informant #938188EA7, and Shelby County Sheriff’s informant #2282, relating to Tony Von Carruthers.

Please provide:

1. The original CrimeStoppers report and all related recordings, notes, revisions, and communications.
2. Records identifying who supplied the information and who prepared, reviewed, approved, or investigated the report.
3. Records showing whether Shaw was an active informant when the information was supplied.
4. Records of payments, rewards, promises, benefits, or instructions connected to the report or Shaw’s involvement in the Carruthers case.
5. Records showing whether Shaw was described as an independent civilian caller and whether his informant status was disclosed to prosecutors or the defense.
6. Records documenting any concerns about the report’s accuracy or Shaw’s credibility.

These records are sought to determine whether the source was accurately represented and whether any information was fabricated or knowingly misrepresented.

Please provide all releasable portions of responsive records. For any records withheld, please identify the reason for withholding. If records no longer exist, please provide any existing destruction logs or applicable retention schedules.

Donald Askew Jr.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 7 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Kent Hoover, a citizen of Tennessee, in coordination with Donald R. Askew Jr..
